children: Digi International refinanced its debt structure by entering a new $350 million senior secured revolving credit facility on Aug 27, 2026, led by BMO Bank as administrative agent, and concurrently terminating its Dec 7, 2023 revolving credit agreement. The five-year facility includes a $75 million foreign currency sublimit, a $10 million letter-of-credit sublimit, a $10 million swingline, and an accordion feature tied to EBITDA and leverage thresholds. Pricing is based on Term SOFR or a base rate plus a leverage-based margin, with covenants on leverage and interest coverage. The move enhances liquidity for acquisitions and general corporate purposes and extends maturity to Aug 27, 2031.
: Senior secured five-year revolving credit facility with accordion

: Enhance liquidity and fund permitted acquisitions
: Replaced by new amended and restated facility
